authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: Don't homogenize into generic Grixis storm that ignores casualty fodder.
Don't cut the power-2+ body count below what casualty needs.

blueprint_failure_modes.description: No power-2+ creature when the important spell is cast: no copy.
Sacrificing an engine creature (Talrand, Archmage) to casualty trades away the value engine.
Graveyard hate and stack interaction stop the copy loops.

value.interaction: Cheap instant-speed interaction that doubles as the turn's casualty spell.
value.mana: Rituals, rocks and Storm-Kiln Treasures; 31 lands.
value.protection: Free counters protect combo turns; Anhelo himself is cheap to recast.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Anhelo turns one spell per turn into two and makes token makers double as copy fuel; his deathtouch body also blocks.
accepted_role.honest_note: The deck's kills are mostly two-card spell-copy infinites that do not need Anhelo; he is a value engine (one casualty per turn), not the win condition. Calling him 'central' would overstate it.
